title: tabulate

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until provider frequency-table hooks exist.

description: `tabulate(X)` returns value, count, and percent columns. Numeric inputs return a numeric matrix; string-like inputs return a cell array.
behaviors: Positive integer numeric vectors include zero-count rows for missing integer levels between 1 and `max(X)`.
Non-integer numeric values are grouped by exact numeric value and sorted ascending.
Numeric NaNs are omitted from the table and from percentage denominators.
Logical, string arrays, and cell arrays of scalar strings return a cell frequency table.
Percentages are relative to the number of non-missing input elements.

faqs.question: Why does tabulate([1 3 3]) include 2?
faqs.answer: For positive integer numeric vectors, MATLAB includes missing integer levels with zero counts.
